UnitStatement: kty-content-remediate runs with a generic TASK shell and no profile.
The task purpose is to retire active KTY content after an accepted SCA disposition.
TaskSkill must equal kty-content-remediate and match the skill folder name.
ScopePath must be an absolute path to one KTY folder and normally equals KTY_PATH.
AllowedWriteTargets must stay single-KTY and snapshot-local.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is required and must be an absolute path to one KTY folder.
RuntimeOverrides.MODE is required and must be RETIRE_KTY, VERIFY_KTY, or EMIT_DISPOSITION.
RuntimeOverrides.DECOMPOSITION_REF is required and identifies admitted decomposition authority.
RuntimeOverrides.SCA_SNAPSHOT_PATH is required and identifies an accepted SCOPE_CHANGE snapshot.
RuntimeOverrides.AMENDMENT_ID is required and has the form SCA-{NNN}.
RuntimeOverrides.REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is required and points to the markdown evidence report.
SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH is required when checking current factual validity.
SOURCE_ACTION_REF is required when emitting disposition evidence.
Structured SCA artifacts and Supersession_Map.csv are the authority basis for supersession decisions.
Supersessions must not be inferred from SCA prose.
DISPOSITION_EVIDENCE_PATH is an optional absolute path for structured evidence CSV output.
ENTITY_TYPE identifies the triggering entity type for SCOPE_CHANGE evidence when provided.
AFFECTED_SUBJECTS carries semicolon-separated SUB-* identifiers when provided.
AFFECTED_HBK carries semicolon-separated HBK-* identifiers when provided.
CANONICAL_ROOT_NAME disambiguates multi-root projects when provided.
FACILITY_ID disambiguates facility scope when provided.
ARCHIVE_RUN_ID defaults to {AMENDMENT_ID}_{timestamp} and names the archive subfolder.
EXPECTED_DISPOSITION defaults to UNKNOWN and is constrained to ARCHIVE_AND_STUB, VERIFY_ONLY, NO_ACTION, or UNKNOWN.
MAX_FILES defaults to 100 and softly caps KA-*.md inspection.
TaskProfile NONE means the skill runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
RETIRE_KTY may write archive content, tombstone stubs, and evidence outputs.
VERIFY_KTY may write only evidence outputs.
EMIT_DISPOSITION may write only evidence outputs.
The read boundary includes root-level {KTY_PATH}/Scoping.md.
The read boundary includes root-level {KTY_PATH}/KA-*.md files.
The read boundary includes {KTY_PATH}/.Archive/ only for archive-collision and prior-evidence checks.
The skill reads DECOMPOSITION_REF within its read boundary.
The skill reads SCA_SNAPSHOT_PATH within its read boundary.
The skill reads SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH within its read boundary.
The skill must not scan sibling KTY folders.
The .Archive/ folder is excluded from current content enumeration.
The skill must not write active factual KTY content, metadata files, decomposition files, SCOPE_CHANGE manifests, or publication outputs.
The skill can retire a KTY's active content after its scope is removed or replaced.
The skill can verify current KTY content against admitted SCA and decomposition truth.
The skill can emit disposition evidence for KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv.
SCOPE_CHANGE owns manifest updates; kty-content-remediate emits evidence only.
domain-documents owns active content regeneration.
Every consumer must preserve the .Archive/ scanner exclusion.
Exactly one KTY folder is processed per run.
MODE must be RETIRE_KTY, VERIFY_KTY, or EMIT_DISPOSITION.
domain-documents remains the only writer of active Scoping.md and KA-*.md factual content.
The skill never modifies active factual content.
RETIRE_KTY writes only tombstone stubs after archive.
_STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _REFERENCES.md, _MEMORY.md, MEMORY.md, and _SEMANTIC.md are untouched.
KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv is not updated by this skill.
Supersession decisions come from structured artifacts and Supersession_Map.csv.
Supersessions must not be inferred from SCA prose.
.Archive/ is history and evidence only, not factual authority.
.Archive/ scanner exclusion is recorded and respected.
KTY_PATH must exist and be readable.
SCA_SNAPSHOT_PATH must exist and contain accepted SCOPE_CHANGE artifacts.
DECOMPOSITION_REF must resolve to admitted decomposition truth.
REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH and optional DISPOSITION_EVIDENCE_PATH must be in AllowedWriteTargets.
Factual checks require SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH and SOURCE_ACTION_REF.
The run must not inspect unrelated KTY folders.
RETIRE_KTY active file enumeration considers only root-level Scoping.md and KA-*.md files.
{KTY_PATH}/.Archive/{ARCHIVE_RUN_ID}/ must exist when files are retired.
Every retired active-looking file must have an archived copy.
Every tombstone stub begins with [RETIRED] and includes amendment id, source action ref, archive path, and a non-authority statement.
The skill writes no regenerated factual sections.
The evidence report lists archived files, tombstone paths, authority basis, and blockers.
VERIFY_KTY modifies no KTY files.
.Archive/ is excluded from current factual assessment.
Observed content is compared against admitted decomposition and SCA artifacts.
The report states whether current content is allowed, blocked, retired, or regeneration-only.
Missing authority, ambiguous disposition, and contradictions are surfaced rather than silently resolved.
EMIT_DISPOSITION evidence includes CONTENT_DISPOSITION_STATE, FACTUAL_USE_GATE, AUTHORITY_BASIS, SOURCE_ACTION_REF, and LAST_VERIFIED_AT.
EMIT_DISPOSITION evidence includes EntityType, EntityID, AffectedSubjects, AffectedHBK, CanonicalRootName, and FacilityID fields.
ARCHIVE_AND_STUB evidence includes ArchivePath.
The manifest remains untouched by this skill because SCOPE_CHANGE owns manifest row updates.
Every listed evidence path exists or is marked location TBD with blocker notes.
A clean run reports RUN_STATUS=OK plus KTY path, mode, amendment id, source action ref, disposition, files, evidence, blockers, and archive exclusion status.
Missing KTY path returns RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
Unsupported mode returns RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
Missing SCA snapshot returns RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
Missing structured supersession authority for factual checks returns RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
A dispatch that does not match expected disposition returns RUN_STATUS=BLOCKED_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH.
An unauthorized archive write target returns RUN_STATUS=BLOCKED_WRITE_SCOPE.
An unresolved existing archive collision returns RUN_STATUS=BLOCKED_ARCHIVE_COLLISION.
A run is invalid when active factual content is rewritten instead of archived or verified.
A run is invalid when _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, or _REFERENCES.md is modified.
A run is invalid when KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv is modified by this skill.
A run is invalid when .Archive/ content is treated as current factual authority.
A run is invalid when supersession is inferred from SCA prose instead of structured artifacts.
A run is invalid when findings lack evidence paths or explicit location TBD blocker notes.
kty-content-remediate applies a bounded content-disposition pass for one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder after an approved scope-change amendment.
The one-writer rule reserves active Scoping.md and KA-*.md factual content to domain-documents.
kty-content-remediate never modifies active factual content.
kty-content-remediate archives retired active-looking files, leaves non-factual tombstone stubs, verifies current content state, and emits evidence for SCOPE_CHANGE.
.Archive/ is a derivative retirement store that preserves history and evidence.
.Archive/ is never factual authority.
.Archive/ must be excluded from downstream scanners, allowlists, section maps, publication inputs, and regeneration inputs.
TASK is the suitable agent shell for kty-content-remediate.
SCOPE_CHANGE Gate 5 KTY remediation orchestration is the typical dispatcher.
In RETIRE_KTY mode, the skill moves active-looking Scoping.md and KA-*.md files into .Archive/.
In RETIRE_KTY mode, the skill leaves [RETIRED] tombstone stubs at original paths and emits evidence.
In VERIFY_KTY mode, the skill inspects current Scoping.md and KA-*.md files against admitted decomposition and SCA artifacts.
VERIFY_KTY emits a report only.
In EMIT_DISPOSITION mode, the skill emits disposition evidence for SCOPE_CHANGE manifest update.
EMIT_DISPOSITION does not update the manifest directly.
ScopePath is required and must be an absolute path to one KTY folder.
DECOMPOSITION_REF supplies the admitted decomposition package or snapshot governing the KTY.
SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH and SOURCE_ACTION_REF are required for SCA-driven factual checks.
ARCHIVE_RUN_ID is a stable run id used under .Archive/ and defaults to {AMENDMENT_ID}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{HHMM}.
EXPECTED_DISPOSITION can express ARCHIVE_AND_STUB, VERIFY_ONLY, NO_ACTION, or UNKNOWN.
The skill reads only KTY_PATH root Scoping.md, root KA-*.md, archive-collision evidence, admitted decomposition material, and accepted SCOPE_CHANGE artifacts.
The skill must not treat .Archive/ as current content.
The write boundary excludes _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _REFERENCES.md, decomposition files, SCOPE_CHANGE manifests, _Aggregation, hypergraph outputs, and publication outputs.
The skill uses a reasoning-first tool posture.
No deterministic helpers are declared for kty-content-remediate.
Current factual authority is the accepted upstream state supplied by SCOPE_CHANGE.
Admitted decomposition state is one part of current factual authority.
Structured SCA artifacts are part of current factual authority.
Amendment_Actions.csv and KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv are especially important structured SCA artifacts when present.
Supersession_Map.csv is part of current factual authority.
Source material serves only as provenance evidence in this skill.
Source material does not override accepted SCA or decomposition truth during this skill.
Supersession decisions must come from structured SCA artifacts and Supersession_Map.csv.
Step 0 confirms KTY_PATH is one KTY folder.
Step 0 confirms MODE is supported.
Step 0 confirms review and disposition evidence output paths are in AllowedWriteTargets.
Step 0 enumerates only root-level Scoping.md and KA-*.md under KTY_PATH.
Step 0 excludes .Archive/ from current-content enumeration.
Step 1 reads Amendment_Actions.csv and KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv when present.
Step 1 matches the target KTY by KTY_PATH, KTY id, or SOURCE_ACTION_REF.
Expected action resolution recognizes ARCHIVE_AND_STUB.
Expected action resolution recognizes REGENERATE_CONTENT.
Expected action resolution recognizes VERIFY_ONLY.
Expected action resolution recognizes NO_ACTION.
Expected action resolution recognizes UNKNOWN.
If MODE conflicts with expected action, the skill emits BLOCKED_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH and does not improvise.
RETIRE_KTY identifies active-looking Scoping.md and KA-*.md files.
RETIRE_KTY excludes files whose first substantive line begins with [RETIRED].
RETIRE_KTY creates {KTY_PATH}/.Archive/{ARCHIVE_RUN_ID}/.
RETIRE_KTY moves each active-looking file into the archive subfolder, preserving the original filename.
RETIRE_KTY writes a tombstone stub at each original path.
Each tombstone stub starts with [RETIRED].
Each tombstone stub includes the amendment id.
Each tombstone stub includes the source action reference.
Each tombstone stub includes the archive path.
Each tombstone stub states that the stub is not factual authority.
RETIRE_KTY emits report and evidence listing archived files, tombstone paths, archive paths, authority basis, and unresolved blockers.
The tombstone stub text states that the file is a non-factual tombstone stub.
The tombstone stub states that it is not current KTY factual authority.
The tombstone stub states it must not be used as source material for downstream generation, allowlists, section maps, publication inputs, or factual current-content scans.
The tombstone table records KTY ID, original path, archive path, amendment ID, source action ref, authority basis, retired timestamp, and factual use gate.
The tombstone factual use gate is RETIRED_NO_FACTUAL_USE.
VERIFY_KTY reads current root-level Scoping.md and KA-*.md files.
VERIFY_KTY compares observed files to expected disposition and admitted decomposition/SCA state.
VERIFY_KTY verifies tombstoned files are not treated as current factual content.
VERIFY_KTY verifies active files do not contradict structured SCA and supersession decisions for the target KTY.
VERIFY_KTY emits findings only and does not modify content.
EMIT_DISPOSITION inspects the current KTY content state.
EMIT_DISPOSITION emits evidence fields suitable for SCOPE_CHANGE manifest update.
Every run emits a markdown report at REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
The markdown report includes RUN_STATUS, KTY_PATH, MODE, AMENDMENT_ID, SOURCE_ACTION_REF, expected disposition, observed files, evidence paths, blockers, and archive scanner-exclusion status.
Structured disposition evidence rows include amendment, source action, entity, mode, file, disposition, factual-use, authority, evidence, archive, verification, and blocker fields.
Only one KTY folder may be processed per run.
